item.title: Your Go-To Guide for Top Enterprise Architecture Resources
item.description:
Navigating the world of enterprise architecture can be a daunting task, especially when you’re not sure where to find reliable resources. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just dipping your toes into the architecture ocean, this curated list will help you stay ahead of the game.

item.title: Enterprise architecture
item.description: Enterprise architecture is the practice that tries to describe and control an organisation’s structure, processes, applications, systems, and technology in an integrated way.

item.title: Enterprise Architecture Model
item.description: An architecture model is not just useful to provide insight into the current or future situation; it can also be used to evaluate the transition from ‘as is’ to ‘to be'.

item.title: Enterprise Architecture is the structure and the operational blueprint of a company
item.description: Enterprise Architecture is the structure and the operational blueprint of a company.

item.title: Archimate
item.description: Archimate enables the creation of fully integrated models of an organizations enterprise architecture, the motivation behind it, and the programs, projects and migration paths to implement it.
